protocol.input: paired current+3 future blocks; retain future blocks 1:4, flatten to 49152
protocol.metrics: PCA fit only on train. Train explained variance = sum first K eigenvalues / total training variance. Test retained energy = 1 - ||X_test-mu-truncated_projection||^2 / ||X_test-mu||^2, using training mean; test samples are not used to choose the mean or PCA directions.
protocol.variance: sample squared deviations; ratios use same normalization
protocol.overlap: windows from same episode always in same split
protocol.train_samples_limit: rank at most number of training windows - 1
